questions.solution:
**Given:**

In a school of 200 students.

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Students playing cricket = 17% of Total Students

⇒ 17% × 200

⇒ 17 × 2 = 34

**∴ The number of students playing cricket is 34.**

questions.question:
The following pie chart shows the spending of a country on tourism in various districts during a particular year. Total spending of the country ₹15,62,000

Study the pie chart and answer the following question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec9a30aa8e8eaf2056e556c2b7044717b7f7aacd5ca079771299e090b15644d0.png] 

How much less money (in ₹) is spent on district C than on district E ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total spending of the country = ₹15,62,000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec9a30aa8e8eaf2056e556c2b7044717b7f7aacd5ca079771299e090b15644d0.png] 

**Concept used:**

Percentage = (Given value/Total value) × 100

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Money spent on District C = 14% of total money

⇒ District C = 14% of 1562000

⇒ District C = 14/100 × 1562000

⇒ District C = 14 × 15620 = Rs. 218680

Money spent on District C = 18% of total money

⇒ District E = 18% of 1562000

⇒ District E = 18/100 × 1562000

⇒ District E = 18 × 15620 = Rs. 281160

Now difference between money spent of district C and district E

⇒ (Money spent on District E) - (Money spent on District C)

⇒ (281160) - (218680) = Rs. 62480

**∴ Rs. 62480 is spent on District C than on District E.**

The pie chart given below show the runs scored by 5 batsmen in a cricket match. Total runs scored by these batsmen are 300 . Runs scored by a batsman is shown as a percentage of runs scored by all these five batsmen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f852125256623d0f1d9b33d469a865e1c209ef1945d452b014a6d03c92a93f1.png] 

What is the average runs scored in F, I and J?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Percentage of runs for F = 18%, I = 24%, J = 6%; Total runs = 300

**Concept:**

The average of a quantity is the sum of all quantities divided by the number of quantities.

**Solution:**

Calculate runs for F, I, and J: F = 18% of 300 = 54, I = 24% of 300 = 72, J = 6% of 300 = 18

Calculate average: (F + I + J)/3 = (54 + 72 + 18)/3 = 48

**Hence, the average runs scored in F, I and J is 48**

questions.solution:
**Given data:**

Students with either Grade D or Grade E = 11 + 8 = 19%

Total students = 1800

**Calculation:**

Total students with either Grade D or Grade E = 19over100 × 1800 = 342

∴ **Total students with either Grade D or Grade E is 342.**

questions.question: In the given pie-chart, if the female employees in department D is 75%, then how many male employees are in that department?
questions.solution:
Total number of employees = 450

Number of employees in department D = 450 × (8/100) = 36

Number of female employees in department D = 36 × (75/100) = 27

Number of male employees in department D = 36 - 27 = 9

questions.question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie-chart shows the expenditure of a family in percentage. The total monthly income is ₹60,000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e94e3a39398be5c98040ed9fa97c510ce8fd28aa0c240a415aa2509820f3b5b.png] 

After the expenditure on only LIC and travelling, find the total income that remains?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e94e3a39398be5c98040ed9fa97c510ce8fd28aa0c240a415aa2509820f3b5b.png] 

Total income= Rs. 60000

**Concept Used:**

A percentage is a number or ratio that can be expressed as a fraction of 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total expenditure%= 14% + 28% + 15% + 8% + 10% + 25% = 100%

Total expenditure is 100% means it is equal to the total salary

⇒ 100%= 60000

⇒ 1%= 600

According to the question,

⇒ Expenditure in LIC= 8%= 8 x 600= Rs. 4800

⇒ Expenditure in travelling= 14%= 14 x 600= Rs. 8400

⇒ Total Expenditure in LIC and travelling= Rs. 4800 + Rs. 8400= Rs. 13200

⇒ Remaining salary= 60000 - 13200= Rs. 46800

**Hence, After the expenditure on only LIC and traveling the total income that remains is Rs 46800**

questions.question:
The population of 7 villages is shown in the following pie chart.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b77b876e7877757586824b0aaac00709f69569db33eb86b8a6707d9b7d1f904d.png] 

What is the difference between the population of village D & E, if the total population of the all the villages is 60000?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ Total population of all the villages = 60000

⇒ Population of village D = 60000 × (17)/(100) = 10200

⇒ Population of village E= 60000 × (18)/(100) = 10800

⇒ Difference between the population of village D & E = 10800 – 10200 = 600

**Therefore, the difference between the population of village D & E is 600.**
